findings.title: Foundation placement is not connected to CAD extraction
findings.body: The new orchestrator and adapter are isolated from the tested CAD extraction path. The included tests invoke only CadParserService.ExtractFromSegments and never pass its FoundationData results to FoundationPlacementOrchestrator or verify an adapter placement call. Because both production types are newly introduced and no included integration or concrete adapter connects them to the existing workflow, this snapshot demonstrates parsing but does not implement the acceptance behavior of automatically placing foundations from CAD.

findings.title: Resolved level elevation is discarded
findings.body: GetLevelElevationFor(data.Z) returns a level elevation that is checked for finiteness and then ignored; PlaceFoundation receives the original data.Z instead. Consequently, level resolution has no observable influence on placement through this interface. If the resolved elevation is intended to snap or associate the foundation with a level, foundations can be placed at the raw CAD elevation instead.

findings.title: Tests do not cover the newly added placement behavior
findings.body: All four tests cover geometry extraction only. There is no focused test for successful PlaceFoundation invocation, rejection of invalid dimensions or non-finite values, type-creation failure, level-resolution failure, or propagation of coordinates and rotation to the adapter. The core behavior introduced for this feature is therefore unvalidated.

findings.title: Adapter-failure test does not verify placement is skipped
findings.body: The test only asserts that PlaceFoundations does not throw. FailingAdapter.PlaceFoundation is an unobservable no-op, so the test still passes if the orchestrator incorrectly calls it after TryGetOrCreateFoundationType returns false. Record whether PlaceFoundation was called and assert zero calls.

findings.title: Invalid numeric-input coverage omits most placement fields
findings.body: The invalid-number test covers only NaN X and infinite Y. Regressions allowing non-finite Z, Length, Width, or RotationAngle would pass this suite and could propagate invalid CAD data into type creation or placement. Add focused cases for each numeric field and both NaN and infinity where applicable.
